verdict.rationale: Buzz documents creating channels and making them private, a CLI `--visibility open` flag for public channels, per-principal channel memberships, and a benchmarked create-channel-invite-users flow. The admin-side membership controls are thinly evidenced: there is no documentation of removing members, member roles, or join policies for private channels. Community critiques of the private-group permission model are skepticism, not a concrete failure, so they don't create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented member removal and role or permission management per channel, explicit private-channel join and invite policy docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: Spin up a room in seconds. Name it, describe it, make it private.
Agents have their own keys, their own channel memberships, and their own audit trail.
